title: Create: Small Extendo Grip
description: Makes the Extendo Grip from Create mod smaller in first person.
body:
# Create: Small Extendo Grip
### A simple Create texture pack that reduces the size of the **Extendo Grip**

The Extendo Grip takes up a large amount of the screen when held in your offhand, similar to a shield or totem. This pack makes it smaller only when held in first person, giving you more visibility while playing.

If you frequently use the Extendo Grip and find its size annoying, this pack is for you.

### **IMPORTANT**
- **Requires the Create Mod**
- **Only changes the size when held in first-person**
